member.name: M:TAPanelObjectBase.ObjectBaseView.AsyncLoadRecordData
member.summary: Utility method intended to implement asynchronous loading of any record data associated with this view. Loading of the data is delegated to the IRecordDataLoader's LoadRecordData() method, and then the OnRecordDataLoaded() handler is invoked on the view's main UI thread to let the view complete any initialization tasks.

member.name: M:TAPanelObjectBase.ObjectBaseView.OnAsyncLoadComplete(System.IAsyncResult)
member.summary: Callback handler for asynchronous data load worker thread completion. The default handler does nothing and should apply to almost every case but derived types can override this if there's some compelling reason to do that.
member.param: The result of the worker thread operation.

member.name: M:TAPanelObjectBase.ObjectBaseView.OnRecordDataLoaded
member.summary: Notification handler called when asynchronous data loading has been completed. This handler sets up the view's main UI and updates any child panels correspondingly, then calls the callback handler for notification that the view and panels have been initialized so that derived types can perform any additional post-load initialization. Finally the OnInitializationComplete event is fired to notify any interested listeners that the view is ready to go.
